claimBoundary: Qualified by the enclosing unchanged-native-wallet artifact, isolation, trust, funding and cleanup envelope.
payer: The admitted native wallet public BRC-100 interface; no replacement sender key or wallet.
assertions: Signed controlled recipient advertisement is admitted by the real Overlay Engine and resolved through the real Mongo-backed MessageBox lookup service.
The actual native wallet creates and signs the fee-bearing payment and encrypts the message through its public wallet interface.
The recipient decrypts the original payload and internalizes the exact payment output; independent script/ancestry verification and value accounting pass.
The message survives complete service restart, recipient acknowledgment deletes it, and a new message cannot reuse the payment after acknowledgment and another restart.
goTransport: Authenticated HTTP; no native Go WebSocket claim
